note: Triennial election of Banbridge Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. There was no contest: four new members came in for the twenty seats, and all twenty divisions are listed. Returned unopposed in place of Mr. R. H. Boyce. Addresses and occupations printed with the names are not reproduced (privacy rule; gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
